text: If you feel stuck playing a part that isn't really you, that's probably your "Role-Self," and as we grow up it gets hardened by Dopamine and DeltaFosB until it's like a prison. Your addiction is often just the fuel it takes to keep that Role-Self running. So this protocol is about dissolving the chemical glue that holds the false persona together, so your "True-Self" (the person you were before the trauma) can finally come back out.
section: Psychology is the Software; Biology is the Hardware.
reader: someone with trauma, often with addiction, who has done therapy and still reacts the same way, reading to learn why and whether this protocol is for them
